children: Opus Genetics issued a revised data presentation correcting a logMAR-to-ETDRS translation error and reported functional/structural gains in low-dose Cohort 1 with no SAEs.
Revised presentation corrects BCVA ETDRS-letter conversion on Slide 15; individual 3-month treated-eye changes provided for five participants.
OPGx-BEST1 low-dose Cohort 1: well-tolerated in 5/5 participants with no SAEs, no DLTs and no intraocular inflammation.
Functional improvements: 75% (3/4 evaluable) met FDA-aligned microperimetry threshold (≥3 dB in ≥5 loci); 60% showed BCVA gains.
Structural gains: 80% (4/5) had structural improvement; BVMD participants showed reduced vitelliform material, ARB participants had reduced intraretinal fluid.
Presentation added high-res microperimetry grids and individual loci data; Cohort 2 overenrolled (8 pts) with Cohort 2 and 6-month Cohort 1 readouts expected Q2 2027.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Opus Genetics revises Cohort 1 data; corrects BCVA translation, shows functional gains and no SAEs
